lines.text: After twenty years of building the temple and his palace, Solomon rebuilt the cities Hiram had given him and settled Israelites there.
Solomon captured Hamath-zobah, built Tadmor in the wilderness, and rebuilt Upper and Lower Beth-horon as fortified cities.
Solomon made the remaining Hittites and Amorites forced laborers, but he made the Israelites his builders and stonecutters.

wrong_details.true: his men of war, captains, and commanders of chariots and cavalry

lines.text: Solomon moved Pharaoh's daughter out of the house of David because the ark's places were holy, and he offered burnt offerings as Aaron commanded.

wrong_details.true: according to the commandment of Moses

lines.text: After the house of the LORD was completed, Hiram sent ships and sailors, and they brought 450 talents of gold from Ophir.
